producer: Phase 5.1 audit — no code changes, no canon extension decisions
purpose: Document facts and gaps. Compare how each concept is represented across formats/platforms. Never propose canon extensions here.

formatIds.note: IDs anticipate the Phase 5 v2 convention `<provenance>.<slug>.<signatureHash?>.<version>`. Slugs used below are placeholders; real hashes are computed at recognizer time.

confirmedFields: CanonProduct.variants[] (optionValues[], sku, price, compareAtPrice, cost, barcode, grams, dimensions, requiresShipping, taxable, inventoryQty, imageSrc)
CanonProduct.images[] (src, position, alt, variantValue, id?, width?, height?)
observedGapsVsRealData: CanonProduct.metafields[].type — missing (Shopify metafields lose their type; WC meta_data has no type; BC custom_fields plain).
CanonProduct.multilingual — no per-language variant of title/bodyHtml/etc.
CanonOrder.taxLines[] — Canon has scalar `taxes`; WC/Shopify/PS expose per-rate breakdown.
CanonOrder.shippingLines[] — Canon has scalar `shipping`; WC/Shopify expose multi-carrier arrays.
CanonAddress lacks a first/last-name split at address level (order carries `name` composite).

CanonProduct.dates (paid/completed/onSaleFrom/onSaleTo/dateCreated/dateModified) — timestamps live on `identity.timestamps` but only created/modified; sale window is on variant.salePeriod (variant-level, not order-level).
Guest customer (customer_id=0 on order) — no explicit canon marker; the order still carries billing/shipping fine, but `email` may be empty.
canonSnapshot.note: These gaps are OBSERVATIONS, not proposals. Decisions belong to Phase 5.4.

concepts.label: Identité produit (handle/slug/id/timestamps)

prestashop.products.csv.v9.extra: Reference not unique in real stores

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon carries only handle + optional slug/sourceId. Shopify GID / PS multi-lang link_rewrite / BC custom_url object are not modelled.
concepts.handling: transform-only for handle. Extra ids can live in identity.sourceId or sourceExtension.<platform>.

concepts.label: Type de produit (simple / variable / grouped / external / digital / pack / bundle)
concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon has no 'pack' / 'bundle' kind. PS 'combinations' = presence of variants (not a distinct kind).
concepts.handling: transform-only. Map PS 'combinations' → kind='variable'. Keep raw type in sourceExtension when the target has no equivalent.
openQuestions: Should 'pack'/'bundle' be a canon kind, or a merchandising concept? Cross-platform observation: only PS exposes 'pack' natively; Shopify uses Bundle apps.

concepts.label: Options de variation ↔ attributs descriptifs ↔ specifications

shopify.products.csv.v1.shape: up to 3 options, no distinction between variation options and specs — specs go into metafields

shopify.products.api.gql.2026-01.shape: structured, still capped at 3; specs live in metafields with type

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.shape: SAME structure holds BOTH options and specs, discriminated by `variation:true/false`

woocommerce.products.csv.modern.v1.shape: no explicit variation flag; deduced from every variation row filling it

wix.products.csv.v1.shape: typed options; specs go in additionalInfo* / customTextField*

wix.products.api.v3.shape: options are variation only; infoSections are specs

bigcommerce.products.csv.v1.carrier: Options column on Item=Variant rows + modifiers (in packed CSV)
bigcommerce.products.csv.v1.shape: options drive variants; modifiers affect price/stock but aren't variants

prestashop.products.csv.v9.shape: TWO separate files: combinations → variation options, features → specs

prestashop.products.api.v9.shape: 4 endpoints; features and options are STRUCTURALLY different (traps #14–16)

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon already has attributesRich[].forVariation — covers Woo's variation flag AND PS features/options split. But NO parser currently populates attributesRich; specs are dropped into metafields.
concepts.handling: transform-only (populate attributesRich[] with forVariation=false for specs, forVariation=true for options). Legacy metafields carry-through kept for round-trip.

concepts.label: Valeur d'option typée (COLOR hex, SIZE, DROPDOWN, media liée)

wix.products.csv.v1.shape: COLOR carries hex; historical rule: keep label, hex→metafield

wix.products.api.v3.shape: COLOR choice can link to media

shopify.products.api.gql.2026-01.shape: plain; swatch handled via app or metafield

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon values are strings; no field for color hex or linked media.
concepts.handling: transform-only for the label. Color hex → sourceExtension.<platform>.optionColors[value]. Media-linked options currently fall to unmapped[] with reason 'no-canon-field'.
openQuestions: Cross-platform: PS + BC + Wix expose typed options natively. Shopify + WC do not. Concept-map recommends keeping raw string in canon; typing stays in sourceExtension until 4-of-6 platforms need it.

concepts.label: Prix payé / prix barré / promo / fenêtre promo / prix HT vs TTC

shopify.*.carrier: Variant Price + Variant Compare At Price
shopify.*.shape: price = paid, compareAt = strikethrough. Currency at store level.

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.carrier: price (live paid) + regular_price + sale_price + on_sale + date_on_sale_from/to
woocommerce.products.rest.v1.shape: 3 explicit fields; API gives paid directly (opposite of CSV)

bigcommerce.products.csv.v1.carrier: Price + Sale Price + Retail Price + Cost Price

prestashop.products.csv.v9.carrier: Price tax excluded + Wholesale price + Tax rules ID + Ecotax + Unit price ratio + On sale
prestashop.products.csv.v9.shape: price stored HT (ex-VAT); Tax rules ID joins tax_rule_group

prestashop.products.api.v9.carrier: price + wholesale_price + id_tax_rules_group + ecotax + on_sale + specific_price[] (time-bound promos)

prestashop.combinations.csv.v9.shape: DELTA on top of product price/weight (trap #9)

gapVsCanon: Canon carries `price` and `compareAtPrice` scalars — enough for paid/strikethrough.
Canon has salePeriod on variant — covers Shopify date_on_sale_from/to and PS specific_price windows.
Canon has NO tax-inclusive vs tax-exclusive distinction. PS+BC store HT; Shopify+Wix store customer-facing (varies).
Canon has NO ecotax / unit-price / MSRP (retail vs list) concepts.
PS combination price is DELTA — never store as absolute in canon; must be resolved before entering variant.price.
concepts.handling: transform-only for paid/strikethrough (`price_promo` and `price_promo_wc_rest`). Tax mode → sourceExtension. Ecotax/MSRP → unmapped[] with reason 'no-canon-field' (cross-platform partial). PS delta must be resolved by a dedicated transform 'presta_combination_delta_price' before canonicalisation.
openQuestions: Should canon carry `taxIncluded:boolean` at product level? Present in PS+BC (HT) and Shopify+WC (setting-dependent). Recommendation: sourceExtension for now.

concepts.label: Régime de taxe / classe / groupe / TVA par pays

prestashop.products.csv.v9.shape: FK to tax_rules_group; group holds N tax rules by country (trap #8)

concepts.gapVsCanon: PS tax_rules_group is per-country breakdown — canon has only a class name.
concepts.handling: transform-only for taxClass. Country-specific PS rates → sourceExtension.presta.taxRules[]. Cross-platform check needed before promoting to canon.

concepts.label: Images produit / position / alt / variant-image / dimensions

shopify.products.csv.v1.carrier: Image Src + Image Position + Image Alt Text + Variant Image (per row)
shopify.products.csv.v1.shape: one image per row, product rows repeat

woocommerce.products.csv.modern.v1.shape: no alt, no position (implicit by order)

bigcommerce.products.csv.v1.carrier: Internal Image URL (Export) + Image URL (Import) + Image Description + Image Sort Order + Variant Image URL

bigcommerce.products.api.v3.carrier: images[]{url_thumbnail, url_standard, url_zoom, url_tiny, description, sort_order, is_thumbnail}

prestashop.products.api.v9.shape: metadata + separate blob endpoint (trap #7); path derived from id-digit split

gapVsCanon: Canon has width/height already (Phase 2 additive). Not populated by parsers today.
Canon has no 'rendered variants' (Shopify size-URLs, BC url_zoom etc.) — kept as one primary URL.
concepts.handling: transform-only for src/position/alt/dimensions. Video → unmapped[]. Rendered variants → keep highest-res URL as src, others → sourceExtension.

concepts.label: Stock produit / stock par variante / backorders / seuils / multi-shop

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.carrier: manage_stock (bool|'parent') + stock_quantity (int, -1=infinite) + stock_status + backorders + backordered + low_stock_amount

prestashop.products.csv.v9.carrier: Quantity + Minimal quantity + Low stock level + Action when out of stock + Advanced stock management
prestashop.products.csv.v9.shape: product-level only; combinations Quantity in combinations.csv

gapVsCanon: Canon inventoryQty is `number|null`; WC uses -1 for 'infinite/backorderable' — must be resolved to null or clamped by transform.
concepts.handling: transform-only. Populate stockPolicy from WC (manage_stock, backorders, sold_individually). Multi-shop stock → sourceExtension.presta.stockPerShop. WC -1 → inventoryQty=null with stockPolicy.backorders='yes'.
openQuestions: Should CanonVariant.stockPolicy.trackInventory be renamed to match WC/Wix/BC 'tracked' vs 'manageStock' vocabulary? Cross-platform note only, no decision here.

concepts.label: Catégorie / hiérarchie / arbre

shopify.products.csv.v1.shape: single leaf, taxonomy id via app

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.shape: flat list; parent chain requires GET /categories/{id} recursion

bigbuy.presta-import.v1.shape: IDs resolved via second file (existing Question 'need_file')

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon holds ONE path per product; several formats support multiple category attachments (Woo/BC/PS). Currently expressed by multiple entries in categories[] joined ' > '; not a true multi-path model.
concepts.handling: transform-only for the flat path. Multi-category products need a canon decision — for now, first category as canon path, rest into sourceExtension.<platform>.categoryPaths[].
openQuestions: Do we need CanonProduct.categoryPaths: string[][] (multi-attachment)? WC/BC/PS say yes; Shopify says one primary; Wix uses collections (multi). Cross-platform observation flagged for 5.4.

concepts.label: Identifiants produit/variante : SKU ↔ EAN13 ↔ UPC ↔ MPN ↔ ISBN ↔ GTIN

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.carrier: sku + global_unique_id (on line_item; not on variation in v3) + meta_data _sku etc.

prestashop.products.csv.v9.carrier: Reference + EAN13 + UPC + MPN + ISBN (product level) + Reference/EAN13/UPC/MPN on combinations.csv

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon has ONE `sku` and ONE `barcode` per variant. PS/BC/Wix expose UPC + MPN + ISBN as distinct fields.
concepts.handling: transform-only. Primary barcode (EAN13 || UPC || ISBN) → canon.barcode. Extras → sourceExtension.<platform>.identifiers.
openQuestions: Cross-platform: PS+BC+Wix carry UPC/MPN/GTIN separately. Shopify+WC collapse into `barcode` + meta. Concept-map notes: canon extension deferred pending user preference.

concepts.label: Multi-langue (title/description/meta/slug per language)

shopify.*.shape: external to Product record; not in default CSV/GQL response

woocommerce.*.shape: core has NO multi-lang; each translation is a separate post

wix.products.api.v3.carrier: product.description with language variants when translations configured
wix.products.api.v3.shape: language switch at API call level

prestashop.products.api.v9.shape: 8+ translatable fields per product (name, description, description_short, link_rewrite, meta_title, meta_description, available_now, available_later)

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon has no per-language variant. PS is the only platform where multi-lang is native and NON-optional.
concepts.handling: sourceExtension.presta.translations OR default-language collapse (current behaviour). Cross-platform 4-of-6 test fails for now: only PS exposes it natively.
openQuestions: Deferred: `title: {[lang]: string}` vs `translations[]` sidecar. Requires user decision in 5.4 with concrete UX implication.

concepts.label: Multi-shop / multi-canal / publication / visibilité

prestashop.products.csv.v9.carrier: Active + Available for order + Show price + Available online only + Shop + Visibility

prestashop.products.api.v9.carrier: active + available_for_order + show_price + online_only + id_shop_default + associations

concepts.handling: transform-only for base flags. Multi-channel/multi-shop → sourceExtension. Publications per Shopify channel → cross-platform check open.

concepts.label: Metafields / custom fields / typed values
concepts.canonHome: CanonProduct.metafields[]{key, value} — value is STRING, no type

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.shape: no type; internal keys start with `_` (filter rule)

prestashop.*.carrier: — (no native custom-fields concept; features are the closest analogue but structurally different)

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon loses Shopify metafield TYPE. Round-trip Shopify→Shopify would lose typing.
concepts.handling: transform-only for key/value. Type → sourceExtension.shopify.metafieldTypes[key] OR unmapped[] with reason 'no-canon-field'.
openQuestions: Extend metafields[] to {key, value, type?}? Only Shopify exposes strict typing. Cross-platform observation.

concepts.label: Timestamps (created / modified / paid / completed / on-sale window)

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.carrier: date_created, date_modified, date_on_sale_from, date_on_sale_to (+ order-level date_paid, date_completed)

prestashop.products.csv.v9.carrier: Product creation date + Product availability date

gapVsCanon: publishedAt (Shopify) not modelled; can go into identity.timestamps.

concepts.label: Client invité vs enregistré

woocommerce.products.rest.v1.carrier: order.customer_id=0 for guest; billing/shipping still on the order

concepts.gapVsCanon: Canon CanonOrder has no isGuest flag.
concepts.handling: transform-only. Detect customer_id==0 (or is_guest==1) → sourceExtension.<platform>.isGuest OR canon email left empty.

concepts.label: Décomposition financière commande : tax lines, shipping lines, coupons, refunds, transactions
concepts.canonHome: CanonOrder.subtotal + shipping + taxes + total + discountCode/Amount + paymentMethod/transactionId (all scalars)

shopify.*.carrier: order.taxLines[] + shippingLine + refunds[] + transactions[] + fulfillments[] + discountApplications[]

woocommerce.orders.rest.v1.shape: 5 arrays; confirmed live (order #33 has one shipping_line: flat_rate 15.00 €)

bigcommerce.products.api.v3.carrier: tax_total + shipping_cost_ex/inc_tax + coupon_discount + gift_certificate_amount + store_credit_amount + refunded_amount

gapVsCanon: Canon has scalar taxes/shipping; loses per-rate/multi-carrier detail.
concepts.handling: transform-only for scalar totals. Detailed arrays → sourceExtension.<platform>.orderBreakdown{taxLines,shippingLines,refunds,transactions}.

representations.loss: menu_order carries position; SKU often shared across variants (audit-confirmed)

representations.carrier: Product ID join across two files

any→Shopify: option count > 3 must be flagged (Shopify max 3).

representations.shape: SAME structure holds both; discriminated by flag

canonImpact.notes: attributesRich[].forVariation already exists in canon; parsers must populate it.

relations.label: Prix ↔ Promo ↔ Fenêtre promo ↔ Taxe (HT/TTC/deltas)

representations.carrier: price(paid) + regular + sale + date_on_sale_from/to + tax_status + tax_class
Price tax excluded + Tax rules ID + Ecotax + combination Price impact (DELTA)

PS delta → absolute BEFORE variant price is written.

relations.label: Produit ↔ Catégorie ↔ Hiérarchie ↔ Multi-rattachement

canonImpact.notes: Canon already has width/height. Video → unmapped[].

relations.label: Produit ↔ Stock ↔ Stock par variante ↔ Backorders ↔ Multi-shop

conversionRisks: WC -1 = infinite/backorderable — must map to canon.inventoryQty=null + stockPolicy.backorders='yes', not -1.
PS stock is per shop AND per combination — collapsing to canon loses granularity.

line_items[]{name, product_id, variation_id, sku, quantity, price, subtotal, total, meta_data[], global_unique_id, parent_name, image}

canonImpact.notes: CanonProduct.defaultOptionValues + CanonImage.position=0 already model this. PS 'cache_default_attribute' resolved to same via a specific transform.

canonEvolutionOpen: multilingual (only PS native — score 1/6, insufficient for canon promotion; user decision required)
orderFinancialBreakdown (only 2/6 fully native — Shopify + WC; deferred)
categoryPaths (multi-attachment) (4/6 platforms support multi-cat — WC, Wix collections, BC, PS; borderline)
metafield typing (1/6 native — Shopify only; insufficient)
identifiers (upc/mpn/isbn as separate fields) (3/6 native — BC, PS, Wix partial; borderline)
taxIncluded flag (mixed — depends on store setting; likely stays sourceExtension)
isGuest on CanonOrder (universal concept; simple boolean, low cost)
questionsForUser: Confirmer que 5.1 documente les faits sans décider — les 7 items 'canonEvolutionOpen' ne sont PAS des propositions.
Le concept 'kind=pack/bundle' (PS pack) reste-t-il en sourceExtension ou justifie-t-il un canon 'pack' ?
Cross-platform 'multi-attachment de catégories' est à 4/6 — proche du seuil. À discuter en 5.4.
Le PS delta prix combination doit être résolu par un transform DÉDIÉ (`presta_combination_delta_price`) — à ajouter au registre transforms en 5.2.
